params.label: Model
params.description: Which compartments the disease has: sir, seir (latent period), sis (no lasting immunity), sirs and seirs (immunity wanes), seiar (an asymptomatic track).
params.starsim_target: ss.SIR, ss.SEIR, ss.SIS and the EpiChat subclasses in epichat/sim/models.py

params.label: Transmission rate
params.description: Per-contact transmission rate per year; the configure tool sets it from R0. Starsim turns it into a daily probability 1 - exp(-beta / 365).

params.label: Latent period (mean)
params.description: Days between infection and becoming infectious. Required for seir, seirs and seiar; the database incubation period is the usual source.

params.label: Latent period (distribution)
params.description: How the period varies between people: constant (everyone the same), gamma or lognormal (needs sd_days). Migrated scenarios are constant; new scenarios use gamma with an illustrative sd.

params.label: Latent period (sd)
params.description: Standard deviation of the period between people, in days; at most twice the mean. Realized periods are about half a day longer than configured because transitions happen on whole days.

params.label: Infectious period (mean)
params.description: Days an infected person transmits. The database infectious period is the usual source.

params.label: Infectious period (distribution)
params.description: How the period varies between people: constant (everyone the same), gamma or lognormal (needs sd_days). Migrated scenarios are constant; new scenarios use gamma with an illustrative sd.

params.label: Infectious period (sd)
params.description: Standard deviation of the period between people, in days; at most twice the mean. Realized periods are about half a day longer than configured because transitions happen on whole days.

params.label: Immunity duration (mean)
params.description: Days of immunity after recovery before a person can be infected again. Required for sirs and seirs.

params.label: Immunity duration (distribution)
params.description: How the period varies between people: constant (everyone the same), gamma or lognormal (needs sd_days). Migrated scenarios are constant; new scenarios use gamma with an illustrative sd.

params.label: Immunity duration (sd)
params.description: Standard deviation of the period between people, in days; at most twice the mean. Realized periods are about half a day longer than configured because transitions happen on whole days.

params.label: Case fatality ratio
params.description: Share of cases that die at the end of the infectious period. In seiar only symptomatic infections are cases; in the other models every infection is, so a surveillance CFR overstates deaths for diseases with many mild or unreported infections. Surveillance CFRs also carry their own biases.

params.label: Asymptomatic share
params.description: Share of infections that never show symptoms; they still transmit, at rel_trans_asymp of a symptomatic case, and never die of the disease.

params.label: Asymptomatic transmissibility
params.description: Transmissibility of an asymptomatic infection relative to a symptomatic one.

params.label: Susceptibility, children (under 18)
params.description: Multiplier on the susceptibility of children (under 18) (1 leaves it as it is). Applies through the agents' ages, so fetch the demographics first for the elderly to exist; an illustrative assumption unless the database carries it.
params.starsim_target: rel_sus_base of the agents in the group, composed by the TransmissionModifiers connector

params.label: Susceptibility, adults (18 to 64)
params.description: Multiplier on the susceptibility of adults (18 to 64) (1 leaves it as it is). Applies through the agents' ages, so fetch the demographics first for the elderly to exist; an illustrative assumption unless the database carries it.
params.starsim_target: rel_sus_base of the agents in the group, composed by the TransmissionModifiers connector

params.label: Susceptibility, the elderly (65 and over)
params.description: Multiplier on the susceptibility of the elderly (65 and over) (1 leaves it as it is). Applies through the agents' ages, so fetch the demographics first for the elderly to exist; an illustrative assumption unless the database carries it.
params.starsim_target: rel_sus_base of the agents in the group, composed by the TransmissionModifiers connector

params.label: Case fatality ratio, children (under 18)
params.description: Share of cases among children (under 18) that die; unset means the overall p_death. An illustrative assumption until the database carries fatality by age.
params.starsim_target: the per-agent death draw (ss.bernoulli with an age-dependent probability)

params.label: Case fatality ratio, adults (18 to 64)
params.description: Share of cases among adults (18 to 64) that die; unset means the overall p_death. An illustrative assumption until the database carries fatality by age.
params.starsim_target: the per-agent death draw (ss.bernoulli with an age-dependent probability)

params.label: Case fatality ratio, the elderly (65 and over)
params.description: Share of cases among the elderly (65 and over) that die; unset means the overall p_death. An illustrative assumption until the database carries fatality by age.
params.starsim_target: the per-agent death draw (ss.bernoulli with an age-dependent probability)

params.label: Presymptomatic transmissibility
params.description: Transmissibility of an agent in the latent period as a fraction of the infectious value; 0 means no transmission before symptoms. Raises the effective infectious days the R0 formula uses.
params.starsim_target: rel_trans_base of exposed agents, who become transmission sources

params.label: Immunity waning (sis)
params.description: Rate per year at which immunity after an sis infection decays; 0 reproduces the classic SIS with no immunity.

params.label: Immunity boost (sis)
params.description: How much immunity an sis infection adds (0 to 1); 0 means none.

params.label: Seeding mode
params.description: fraction: each agent starts infected with probability value; count: exactly value agents start infected.

params.label: Seed size
params.description: A fraction between 0 and 1 (mode fraction) or a whole number of agents from 1 to n_agents (mode count).

params.label: Seeding day
params.description: Day the seed infections happen; 0 means at the start.

params.label: Initially immune
params.description: Share of the non-seeded population that starts immune (a past epidemic or a vaccination campaign before day 0). In sirs and seirs this immunity wanes like everyone else's; in sis at sis_waning.

params.label: Contact network
params.description: random: everyone has n_contacts fresh random contacts a day; age_structured: three age groups mixing by a contact matrix (POLYMOD-like by default, the country's Prem 2021 matrix after fetch_demographics); hybrid: households, schools, workplaces and community as in Covasim, the structure layer interventions act on. At the same R0 the final size is close on every network.

params.label: Contacts per day
params.description: Mean number of contacts per person per day on the random network; no effect on the age-structured and hybrid networks.

params.label: Contacts distribution
params.description: constant: everyone has exactly n_contacts a day; poisson: the daily number varies around n_contacts. Random network only; the R0 is unchanged.

params.label: Contact duration
params.description: Days a random-network contact lasts before it is replaced; 0 remakes every contact daily. Longer contacts slow spread by local depletion, so the R0 shown is approximate and the measured R0 is the one to quote.

params.label: Network transmission multiplier
params.description: Multiplies the per-contact probability on the network; 1 leaves beta as it is.
params.starsim_target: ss.RandomNet(beta=...) or the mixing matrix scale

params.label: Contacts, children (under 18) to children (under 18)
params.description: Contacts per day a target among the children (under 18) has with sources among the children (under 18) on the age-structured network (rows source, columns target; POLYMOD-like default, the country's Prem 2021 value after fetch_demographics).

params.label: Contacts, children (under 18) to adults (18 to 64)
params.description: Contacts per day a target among the adults (18 to 64) has with sources among the children (under 18) on the age-structured network (rows source, columns target; POLYMOD-like default, the country's Prem 2021 value after fetch_demographics).

params.label: Contacts, children (under 18) to elderly (65 and over)
params.description: Contacts per day a target among the elderly (65 and over) has with sources among the children (under 18) on the age-structured network (rows source, columns target; POLYMOD-like default, the country's Prem 2021 value after fetch_demographics).

params.label: Contacts, adults (18 to 64) to children (under 18)
params.description: Contacts per day a target among the children (under 18) has with sources among the adults (18 to 64) on the age-structured network (rows source, columns target; POLYMOD-like default, the country's Prem 2021 value after fetch_demographics).

params.label: Contacts, adults (18 to 64) to adults (18 to 64)
params.description: Contacts per day a target among the adults (18 to 64) has with sources among the adults (18 to 64) on the age-structured network (rows source, columns target; POLYMOD-like default, the country's Prem 2021 value after fetch_demographics).

params.label: Contacts, adults (18 to 64) to elderly (65 and over)
params.description: Contacts per day a target among the elderly (65 and over) has with sources among the adults (18 to 64) on the age-structured network (rows source, columns target; POLYMOD-like default, the country's Prem 2021 value after fetch_demographics).

params.label: Contacts, elderly (65 and over) to children (under 18)
params.description: Contacts per day a target among the children (under 18) has with sources among the elderly (65 and over) on the age-structured network (rows source, columns target; POLYMOD-like default, the country's Prem 2021 value after fetch_demographics).

params.label: Contacts, elderly (65 and over) to adults (18 to 64)
params.description: Contacts per day a target among the adults (18 to 64) has with sources among the elderly (65 and over) on the age-structured network (rows source, columns target; POLYMOD-like default, the country's Prem 2021 value after fetch_demographics).

params.label: Contacts, elderly (65 and over) to elderly (65 and over)
params.description: Contacts per day a target among the elderly (65 and over) has with sources among the elderly (65 and over) on the age-structured network (rows source, columns target; POLYMOD-like default, the country's Prem 2021 value after fetch_demographics).

params.label: Contact matrix source
params.description: Where the contact matrix came from: polymod_default (European), prem_2021:<ISO3> (the country's synthetic matrix) or user.

params.label: Household size
params.description: Mean household size on the hybrid network (Poisson); the country's value after fetch_demographics.

params.label: School contacts
params.description: Mean daily contacts in the school layer of the hybrid network (Covasim's value, illustrative).

params.label: Workplace contacts
params.description: Mean daily contacts in the workplace layer of the hybrid network (Covasim's value, illustrative).

params.label: Community contacts
params.description: Mean daily contacts in the community layer of the hybrid network (Covasim's value, illustrative).

params.label: Household transmissibility
params.description: Relative transmissibility of a household contact on the hybrid network (Covasim's value, illustrative).

params.label: School transmissibility
params.description: Relative transmissibility of a school contact on the hybrid network (Covasim's value, illustrative).

params.label: Workplace transmissibility
params.description: Relative transmissibility of a workplace contact on the hybrid network (Covasim's value, illustrative).

params.label: Community transmissibility
params.description: Relative transmissibility of a community contact on the hybrid network (Covasim's value, illustrative).

params.label: School age, from
params.description: Youngest age in the school layer of the hybrid network.

params.label: School age, to
params.description: Age at which agents leave the school layer (excluded).

params.label: Working age, from
params.description: Youngest age in the workplace layer of the hybrid network.

params.label: Working age, to
params.description: Age at which agents leave the workplace layer (excluded).

params.label: Births and deaths
params.description: Whether people are born and die of other causes during the run.

params.label: Birth rate
params.description: Births per 1,000 people per year.

params.label: Death rate
params.description: Deaths from other causes per 1,000 people per year.

params.label: Share under 18
params.description: Percent of the population aged 0 to 17; with the other two shares it assigns ages on the age-structured network.

params.label: Share 18 to 64
params.description: Percent of the population aged 18 to 64.

params.label: Share 65 and over
params.description: Percent of the population aged 65 or more.

params.label: Country
params.description: ISO3 code of the country whose demographics are used.

params.label: Fill demographics from the country
params.description: Whether the service fills birth and death rates and contacts from country data when they are still at their defaults.

params.label: Demographics year
params.description: Year of the country data used.

params.label: Demographics source
params.description: Where the filled demographics came from.

params.label: Age source
params.description: Where the simulated ages come from: default (Starsim's uniform 0 to 60), shares (uniform ages within the three shares) or un_wpp (the country's single-year age pyramid, bundled from UN WPP 2024).

params.label: Intervention type
params.description: vaccine (routine or campaign, with efficacy, age range and waning), treatment (capacity-limited, with a delay and an efficacy), seasonality (a yearly cycle in transmission), contact_reduction (a layer's contacts scaled over a window: school closure, distancing), transmission_reduction (every contact's transmissibility scaled over a window: masks).

params.label: Coverage
params.description: Vaccine: yearly probability each susceptible person is vaccinated; treatment: share of infectious people treated each day.

params.label: Start day
params.description: Day the intervention begins. A vaccine starting on day 0 is stored as disease.initial_immune_frac instead.

params.label: Treatment capacity
params.description: Most people treated per day.

params.label: Scale
params.description: Seasonality: size of the yearly cycle (0.2 means transmission moves between 80% and 120% of beta); contact_reduction and transmission_reduction: the fraction removed over the window (0.3 keeps 70%; 1 removes everything).

params.label: Seasonal shift
params.description: Fraction of a year by which the cycle is shifted.

params.label: End day
params.description: Day the intervention ends; unset means the run's end.
params.starsim_target: ss.routine_vx(end_year=...), the window of a reduction

params.label: Vaccine delivery
params.description: routine: coverage is the yearly probability each eligible person is vaccinated; campaign: the coverage is reached uniformly over the window.

params.label: Efficacy
params.description: Vaccine: protection against infection, 1 means full; treatment: the share of treated cases cured. Illustrative unless the database carries it.

params.label: Leaky protection
params.description: true: every recipient keeps 1 - efficacy of their susceptibility; false: a share efficacy of recipients is fully protected.

params.label: Vaccine age, from
params.description: Youngest age vaccinated; unset means everyone.

params.label: Vaccine age, to
params.description: Age at which vaccination stops (excluded); unset means everyone.

params.label: Protection duration
params.description: Days the vaccine's protection lasts; unset means permanent.

params.label: Treatment delay
params.description: Days after becoming infectious before treatment can start.

params.label: Transmissibility while waiting
params.description: Relative transmissibility of an agent waiting for treatment (0.5 halves it).

params.label: Treat symptomatic only
params.description: seiar: leave asymptomatic agents untreated.

params.label: Layer
params.description: Which hybrid layer a contact reduction scales: household, school, work, community, or all; the random and age-structured networks take all only.

params.label: Agents
params.description: Number of simulated people; results scale to the real population.

params.label: Duration
params.description: Length of the run in years.

params.label: Replicates
params.description: How many seeds to run; the result shows the median run with 10 to 90% bands.

params.label: Random seed
params.description: Seed of the first replicate; unset means 1.

params.label: Calibrate beta by measurement
params.description: On the hybrid network, or with a contact duration above 0, the R0 formula is approximate: a short pilot in which only the seeds transmit measures R0 and corrects beta until the measurement is within 5% of the target (or within its own standard error when that is larger), at most three times. Off, the formula's beta runs as it is.

params.label: Fit target
params.description: The outcome the run is fitted to: attack_rate (share infected), peak_day or peak_infections (in agents).

params.label: Fit value
params.description: The value to reach: a fraction for attack_rate, a day for peak_day, agents for peak_infections.

params.label: Fit lever
params.description: The parameter the fit moves within its bounds: disease.beta or network.network_beta.
